 ​⁠7 Winona Ryder Movies Before Stranger Things That Prove She Ruled 90s​
 Long before Stranger Things, Winona Ryder was one of Hollywood's most loved stars. From cult classics to romantic dramas, revisit seven of her most memorable movies from the 80s and 90s that prove her talent and timeless appeal.
 Swastika Pramanik Updated Oct 31, 2026, 08:56 AM IST 
 01 / 08 Share 
 Before Hawkins, Winona Ryder was the ultimate 90s movie star
 Before she became everyone's favourite Joyce Byers in Stranger Things, Winona Ryder was already ruling Hollywood with her unforgettable performances and iconic 90s roles. From playing a rebellious teenager in Heathers to bringing a gothic character to life in Beetlejuice, she had a way of making every character stand out. Whether it was romance, drama or dark comedy, Winona did it all. If you want to revisit her best work before the Netflix series made her popular all over again, these seven movies deserve a spot on your watchlist.
 02 / 08 Share 
 1. Edward Scissorhands (1990)
 Edward Scissorhands is a fantasy romance about Edward, an artificial man who has scissors instead of hands and lives alone in a mansion until a woman brings him into her suburban neighbourhood. Things take a turn when he struggles to fit into a world where people judge him for being different. Winona Ryder plays Kim Boggs, the daughter of the woman who takes Edward in. Her character initially fears Edward but slowly begins to understand him and falls in love with him. Winona brings a sweet, innocent and emotional side to Kim, making her relationship with Edward one of the most memorable parts of the film. This movie is available for rent on Amazon Prime Video.
 03 / 08 Share 
 2. Mermaids (1990)
 Set in the 1960s, Mermaids follows a single mother, Rachel, who keeps moving from one place to another with her two daughters. The story mainly focuses on Charlotte, the older daughter, who is trying to figure out her identity while dealing with her mother's unconventional lifestyle and her own growing feelings about love and religion. Winona plays Charlotte Flax, a teenager who wants to be more mature but is still figuring out who she is. She captures that awkward teenage phase really well, balancing Charlotte's curiosity, frustration and vulnerability. Her chemistry with Cher and the younger Christina Ricci also makes the film worth watching. The movie is available for rent on Amazon Prime Video. 
 04 / 08 Share 
 3. Bram Stoker’s Dracula (1992)
 This gothic horror film follows Count Dracula, who travels to England in search of Mina Murray, a woman he believes resembles his long-lost love. As Dracula's obsession grows, Mina finds herself caught in a dangerous world of romance, mystery and supernatural horror. Winona plays Mina Murray and also appears as Elisabeta, Dracula's former love. She brings a gentle yet determined quality to Mina, while her portrayal of Elisabeta adds a tragic romantic angle to the story. Her performance works well with the film's dramatic atmosphere and makes her an important part of this dark adaptation of the classic novel. This movie is available for streaming on SonyLIV and for rent on AppleTV.
 05 / 08 Share 
 4. The Age of Innocence (1993)
 Set in 1870s New York, the story follows Newland Archer, a wealthy lawyer who falls in love with Ellen Olenska even though he is engaged to her cousin, May Welland. The film explores love, social expectations and the pressure to follow society's rules. Winona plays May Welland, a young woman who seems innocent and cheerful but is more observant than people give her credit for. She keeps May's emotions quite subtle, using her expressions and quiet reactions to show that there is more to the character than what she says. This performance also earned Winona Ryder an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress. The movie is available for rent on Amazon Prime video and AppleTV.
 06 / 08 Share 
 5. Reality Bites (1994)
 Reality Bites follows a group of friends trying to figure out life after college, as they deal with career struggles, relationships and the pressure to become successful adults. Winona plays Lelaina Pierce, an aspiring filmmaker who is trying to build her career while getting caught between two very different men. She makes Lelaina feel relatable, especially when she is confused about her future and unsure of the choices she is making. Her performance captures the uncertainty of being young and trying to find your place in the world, which is also why the movie became such a defining film of the 90s. The movie is currently available for streaming on Amazon Prime Video.
 07 / 08 Share 
 6. Little Women (1994)
 Based on Louisa May Alcott's classic novel, the story is about March sisters as they grow up during and after the American Civil War. The film explores their relationships, dreams, heartbreaks and struggles as they try to find their own paths in life. Winona plays Jo March, the independent and outspoken sister who dreams of becoming a writer. She brings a lot of energy and emotion to Jo, making her feel ambitious, stubborn and loving at the same time. Winona's performance was widely appreciated, which earned her an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress. If you enjoy period dramas with strong female characters, this one is definitely worth revisiting. This movie is available for streaming purposes on SonyLIV and Amazon Prime Video.
 08 / 08 Share 
 7. Girl, Interrupted (1999)
 Set in the late 1960s, Girl, Interrupted follows Susanna Kaysen, an 18-year-old who is admitted to a psychiatric hospital and meets a group of young women dealing with their own struggles. As she forms friendships with them, Susanna begins to question her identity and what it means to be mentally unwell. Winona plays Susanna, a character who feels lost and disconnected from the world around her. She gives a quiet, vulnerable performance that captures Susanna's confusion and inner conflict, especially as she tries to understand herself. The film also stars Angelina Jolie, whose performance as Lisa adds another layer to the story. The movie is available for rent on Amazon Prime Video or AppleTV.
